import requests

url = 'http://localhost:8000/show_data'
data = {
    'start_time': '2025-12-08 11:13:29',
    'end_time': '2025-12-08 11:15:29',
    'con_status': True,
    'direction': 'inbound',
    'language': 'en',
    'duration': 300.0
}
response = requests.post(url, json=data)
print(response.json())
